metaTitle: Custom Field Co Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Field Co blankets for your next promotion. Perfect for corporate gifts, trade shows, and employee rewards.
introHtml: Field Co blankets combine outdoor durability with cozy comfort, making them a standout choice for brands that want to give something both practical and memorable. Whether you choose the recycled PET sherpa blanket for eco-conscious campaigns or the classic buffalo plaid for winter events, each blanket offers generous sizing and soft texture. Decorate with your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a premium look that recipients will use for years.
heroAltText: Custom Field Co blankets with embroidered logo, including sherpa and picnic styles displayed on grass
